typical_titles: CEO or Group CEO; Managing Director; Unit head of a hospital cluster
owns: Network budget, new-city plans, vendor spend
cares_about: Occupancy, ARPOB (revenue per occupied bed), cost per patient contact, ramp-up of new hospitals
blocks_if: Cannot see a payback inside the quarter; patient-safety or brand risk
where_found: Concall participant list (cover page of each transcript)
label: PUBLISHED

typical_titles: Head of Patient Experience; Head of Contact Centre; Chief Marketing and Customer Officer; Head of Patient Acquisition
owns: Appointment calls, lead conversion, patient follow-up, call centre staff
cares_about: Missed calls, lead conversion, patient satisfaction, regional language reach. Example title: Chief Marketing and Customer Officer at Redcliffe Labs (Exotel page).
blocks_if: Voice agent hurts patient trust or duplicates the current CRM
where_found: LinkedIn title search; vendor case-study quotes
label: INFERENCE

typical_titles: Contact centre team lead; front-desk and OPD registration head; TPA desk and revenue cycle head
owns: Daily call queues, pre-authorisation calls, discharge-day calls
cares_about: Fewer abandoned calls, clean hand-off to a person, claim turnaround
blocks_if: Bot adds work when it hands off with no context
where_found: LinkedIn title search; hospital website contact pages
label: INFERENCE

typical_titles: Chief Information Officer; Chief Digital Officer; Head of IT and HIS (hospital information system)
owns: HIS, CRM and telephony integration, vendor security review
cares_about: Integration with HIS and CRM, ABDM links, uptime, data location. Rainbow says it is building a new CRM and HIS design.
blocks_if: No API into the HIS; data leaves India; no audit log
where_found: Concall quote on CRM and HIS; LinkedIn title search
label: FOUNDER

typical_titles: Medical Director; Chief Medical Officer; Head of Quality (clinical safety blocker)
owns: Clinical protocols, what a bot may say to a patient
cares_about: No medical advice from the bot, fast hand-off to a nurse or doctor, NABH quality rules
blocks_if: Bot answers a clinical question or gives a result
where_found: Annual report KMP list; hospital leadership page; NABH quality head
label: INFERENCE

typical_titles: Data privacy officer; Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
owns: DPDP Act consent notice, retention, breach duty
cares_about: Consent before outbound health calls, data kept in India, audit trail. Rule 4 (consent managers) starts 14 Nov 2026. Rules 3 and 5 to 16 start 18 months after 14 Nov 2025.
blocks_if: No consent record per call; no deletion path
where_found: Stock exchange filings (Company Secretary and Compliance Officer signs each filing); annual report; DPDP notice page
label: PUBLISHED

typical_titles: Head of Procurement; Head of Purchase and Supply Chain; Group CFO office
cares_about: Per-minute price against the cost of agent time, pilot with a pass bar, exit terms
blocks_if: No fixed price; no named hospital reference
where_found: Annual report KMP list (CFO); LinkedIn title search
label: INFERENCE

typical_titles: Group COO; Chief Digital Officer; Group Director for growth
cares_about: Faster ramp of new hospitals; one script set across states. Example: Narayana lists a Group Chief Operating Officer on its call.
blocks_if: Pilot needs hospital staff time they do not have
label: INFERENCE
